spans.s: मच् (I) vi. 1Ā (pres. मचते) 1. To be wicked, to be a cheat; 2. to be vain or proud.
मच् (II) vt. or vi. 1Ā (pres. मंचते) 1. To grow high; 2. to hold; 3. to adore; 4. to shine.
मचर्चिका f. (at the end of a compound.) Excellence, anything excellent of it’s kind, e.g. गोमचर्चिका ‘an excellent cow.’
मच्छ m. A fish (probably a corruption of मत्स्य).
माचल m. 1. a robber, a thief; 2. a crocodile.
